name: Spain
overview: Scripture references Spain through the ancient maritime region of Tarshish, highlighting its significance in God's plans for the nations. The ships of Tarshish are depicted as vessels that bring tribute and wealth, symbolizing distant peoples responding to God's glory (Isaiah 60:9; Psalms 72:10). Furthermore, God promises to send messengers to Tarshish and other far-off lands to declare His fame among the Gentiles (Isaiah 66:19). The apostle Paul’s intention to visit Spain reflects this missionary vision, aiming to carry the gospel to the westernmost parts of the known world, fulfilling the purpose of spreading Christ-centered salvation to all nations.
